plan.title: Single-stage RFQ template shows pricing sheet

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type from the default RFP to RFQ and retain lot-based awarding.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Select the first available RFQ template so its sheet configuration is applied.
Verify that the template rendered all expected pricing-sheet columns.
Verify the expected sheet configuration control is usable.
Verify the expected sheet upload control is usable.
Verify the expected Details control is usable.
Verify the expected Price Components control is usable.
Verify the expected ranking control is usable.
Verify that Participants becomes clickable after template selection.
Verify that Terms & Conditions becomes clickable after template selection.
Verify that the schedule chip is present after the template is selected.
